how: Each purchase gets stars for how many days it took to submit: within 7 days 5, within 14 days 4, within 30 days 3, within 60 days 2, later 1. Purchases not submitted yet count by how long they have waited, after the first week. For a card purchase the count starts when its bank row is in the app, since it cannot be submitted before. The last six months weigh double, and a small part of the score is how many were approved without being sent back. The score has no consequences, it is only there for you.
